checks.detail: Blocked/full-unassessed for aggregate acceptance. Independent ordinary-input checks established preference persistence, working defaults and sensitivity, audio mute routing, manual saves/load, dialogue pause ownership and save failure followed by retry. Condition 0 fails because focused settings controls and binding feedback can be hidden. Complete option-effect, resolution/scale, active combat-pause and caller-boundary evidence remains incomplete. Correction inspected the existing save through ordinary input and obtained a stable unarmed state, not the missing earned-ammunition or active-combat states. All three selected evidence issues remain unresolved. Broader continuity debt does not expand frozen acceptance. A fresh final runtime log contained only engine/bridge messages.

output_contract.risk_handoff_policy: Risk context is host-owned and must be echoed through bindings; Tester should explicitly inspect the stated validation result and cite bound evidence when risk remains unresolved.

required_criteria.requirement: 完成与标题共用主题的设置和暂停/存档页面，PRD6.1/6.9：音量（主/音乐/音效）、画质、鼠标灵敏度与键位、文本100/150/200%、镜头震动/减少动态、伤害数字开关有真实效果并重启保留。标签/滑条/开关/焦点与禁用状态精制且可读；返回上级保持来源位置，默认/应用等操作真实有效，不展示调试信息。暂停包含继续、两手动槽保存/加载、设置、返回标题、退出；保存成功/失败提示真实，命数与检查点来自当前数据。世界敌人/移动/攻击/投射物/刷新/冷却/奖励全部暂停；设置从暂停/对话/剧情进入时拥有正确嵌套暂停归属，关闭子页不提前恢复世界，返回不误攻击。Tester普通输入、重启与暂停嵌套验证，比较已指定游戏级参考图，不能交文本堆砌或假功能菜单。

developer_outcome.summary: Retained implementation and ordinary menu/save/restart checks passed; recovery verified existing source binding and native runnable readiness. Independent option/rendering/fault/caller/layout matrices and all three evidence issues remain unresolved. The prior frozen title-loading timeout remains failed.

risk_note.summary: Independent acceptance is most likely to remain insufficient_evidence for audible music/effects separation, real rendering-cost changes, persistent save failure, unavailable cinematic/skill callers and the existing one-time-event/obstacle sequences.
risk_note.validation: Use an early bounded ordinary-input settings/pause smoke to establish observable effect and ownership bindings, then independent restart, audio, fault and resolution/scale checks. Request missing legal fixtures through Host; record unavailable cells explicitly and collect runtime logs after the final interaction.
risk_note.why_now: The owning menu module changes the precise navigation, preference and save boundaries needed by the current phase and existing debt; finding an unavailable observation path early prevents another loop of cosmetic adjustments.

task_requirements.requirement: Title and in-game settings provide coherent audio, graphics, controls and readability groups with authoritative values, usable pointer/keyboard focus, distinguishable interaction states and effective default/application behavior. Master/music/effects volume, quality, mouse sensitivity/key bindings, 100/150/200% text, camera shake including off, reduced motion and damage numbers produce their real.

Pause provides continue, two manual save/load slots, settings, return to title and quit, with true slot availability, chapter/checkpoint/life data and success/failure/retry feedback. Returning from a child page restores its source position and focus; world movement, AI, attacks, projectiles, spawning, damage, cooldowns, rewards and floating feedback remain frozen until the final pause owner exits.
